Question 10
?

Which integral gives the area of the finite region bounded by y=3x2−5x and y=6−2x2−4x?

a
∫−16/5(−5x2+x+6)dx
b
∫1/56/5(−5x2−x+2)dx
c
∫−11/5(x2+x+3)dx
d
∫−12/5(5x2+x+4)dx
e
∫16/5(−5x2+5x−6)dx
Submit
